event_sequence: White car appears behind blue car on the same approach.
Blue car continues through the junction turning across the path of the following white car.
Front of blue car and front of white car collide.

Blue car pushes the white car backwards and the white car leaves the road onto the footway. The white car comes to rest half on the footway and half on the road facing the way it came. The blue car stops on the road facing its original direction of travel with its bonnet open.

report.summary: Impact between car-0 and car-1 occurred at t = 4.776 s, with timing uncertainty about 0.042 s. From t = 3.576 to 4.576 s, car-0 was travelling at 21.2 km/h (90% interval 18.9 to 23.4) and car-1 was travelling at 54.4 km/h (90% interval 50.2 to 58.7). The claim by s1 about the speed of the white car was not consistent with the footage. The claim by s2 about the speed of the blue car was consistent with the footage. The claim by s2 about braking by the white car was consistent with the footage, with no sustained braking detected before impact.
